rule_condition: The 70-point shield absorbs damage first. No damage modifiers apply, and the attack has no control effect.
battle_description: Before the attack, Neris has 560 of 900 health and a 70-point shield. Korr's basic attack deals 210 physical damage. The shield absorbs damage before health, and this attack applies no control effect; no damage modifiers are active.
transition_summary: Korr's attack deals 210 damage. Neris's shield absorbs 70 and is depleted; the remaining 140 reduces health from 560 to 420. Neris remains alive with no control effect.
